Rhea (People Ops): Quick one 10: Marco Diaz (emp 51345) moved from ON to QC mid-pay period (effective 09/12). Payroll paid him full ON provincial tax for 09/01-09/15. Need proration to QC rates for 09/12-09/15.
Omar (Payroll): Okay. Do we have the move effective timestamp in HRIS?
Luis (HRIS): Yes 13: worker_record updated 2024-09-12 08:22 ET; province changed ON->QC. Sync to payroll succeeded on 09/12 at 09:00 but the tax engine used the payroll run cutoff of 09/01 config.
Nadia (Manager): Marco flagged his net pay being lower earlier and is worried. Can we correct without reducing his pay?
Sophie (Finance): For accounting we need the tax delta and ER tax differences. Omar, can you estimate the employee tax swap and whether an off-cycle top-up or credit is needed?
Omar (Payroll): Quick calc: gross for period $2,100; QC provincial rates lower by ~3.5% vs ON for that bracket -> employee delta ~ $73.50. Employer tax effect negligible. I'll run precise numbers and either queue a reversing/credit off-cycle or adjust next run. Preference is to credit now (don't reduce Marco's net).
payroll-bot: Ticket PR-2024-3412 created (Marco Diaz provincial tax proration).
Omar (Payroll): Posted credit off-cycle for $73.50 to make Marco whole; attached corrected stub. ETA posting timestamp 1718301270.
Rhea (People Ops): Thanks all. Luis, please add guard to prevent using payroll-run cutoff when mid-period jurisdiction changes. I'll notify Marco once stub is updated.
Luis (HRIS): Will add retry and a jurisdiction-change check to the sync job.
Sophie (Finance): Booking accrual: payroll liability $73.50. Closing loop.
